ReviewDialog.photo_thumbnail: w-16 h-16 rounded-lg object-cover border border-slate-200 hover:scale-105 transition-transform cursor-pointer
ReviewDialog.admin_reply_box: mt-3 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-700

accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA 4.5:1 minimum on all labels and navigation items
accessibility.screen_reader: aria-label for all icon-only buttons like toggle sidebar, chat badge, status update

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark left sidebar (#0F172A) stays persistent with all 13 nav sections: Ringkasan, Produk, Pesanan, Voucher, Banner, Kategori, Resep, Ulasan, Konsumen, Komplain, Chat, Laba Rugi, Pengaturan Toko.
Add unread notification badge on 'Chat' nav menu item.
Provide a smooth responsive drawer for mobile layout using standard Shadcn Sheet or mobile menu toggle.
Overview section must feature 6 crisp metric stat cards: Pendapatan, Laba Kotor, Total Pesanan, Menunggu Bayar, Produk Aktif, Rating Rata-Rata.
Recharts area/bar combined chart must show 14-day daily sales and net daily profit with custom tooltip and green/sky gradients.
Implement recent orders list with interactive status filter badges (Semua, Menunggu, Diproses, Selesai, Dibatalkan) and direct status update action buttons.
Build the customer-facing 'Resep' tab/page with AI photo grid, cooking time, serving count, linked product ingredients, and a prominent 'Masukkan Semua Bahan ke Keranjang' button.
Build 'Admin Resep' creation tab with form inputs for AI image selection, ingredient search & link to store products, and step-by-step editor.
Build 'Ulasan' (Reviews) system with 1-5 star ratings, customer comment, customer attached photos, product detail reviews list, and admin reply/hide toggle.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements across components.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glassmorphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing (2-3x default) to keep layouts breathable.
Subtle grain textures, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute for automated testing.
